description: Erection of a single storey rear and single storey side extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01A (Proposed)  Received:  28 August 2019; 01A (Existing)  Received:  19 September 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The rear and side extensions hereby approved shall be constructed only with matching cream rendered walls, white UPVC windows, doors, guttering and drainpipes and felt/ fibreglass flat roof.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the single storey rear extension to which the hereby approved replacement roof relates and no additional doors shall be inserted in the side extension without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
